comment: Fixed-input KAT for multi-chunk STREAM seal and name-MAC. Inputs are frozen; any output change is a regression in the crypto port.

multiChunkSeal.comment: Plaintext: 2*65536+1337 = 132409 bytes. Fill pattern: b[i] = (i*31+7)&0xff. Nonce: 16 bytes of 0xab. Output pins: CAK, segId, fileKey, and SHA-384 of the full sealed output (the SHA-384 pin binds every chunk boundary, every GCM tag, and the chunk-nonce counter sequence across all 3 chunks).

nameMAC.comment: nameMAC = HMAC-SHA-384(nameMACKey, sourceType || 0x00 || name). The nameMACKey is derived from deriveMK(master, runIDBytes) then deriveNameMACKey(mk, runIDBytes). All MAC outputs are 48 bytes, hex-encoded.
